dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress by Geil, Harley & Siverd in the year 1858 in the Clerk's Office of the District Court for the District of Pennsylvania."

"Entered according to Act of Congress by Geil, Harley & Siverd in the year 1858 in the Clerk's Office of the District Court for the District of Pennsylvania." Includes business directories, distance table, census and agricultural statistical table (May 1854), views of public, residential, and commercial buidlings. Insets: Morench -- Addison -- Palmyra -- Medina -- Rollin -- Clinton -- Tecumseh -- Hudson -- Canandaigua -- Blissfield -- Adrian -- Deerfield -- Rome Centre -- Ridgeway -- Riga. LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into 4 panels to enable folding.
